title: Figure 1: Varieties of BioMEMS and sensors made at Arizona State University (collage)
description: Slide-style collage titled "Varieties of BioMEMs and Sensors" combining photographs and micrographs of BioMEMS devices: a small chip held on a fingertip, a microfluidic cartridge, electrode arrays, an "ASU"-labeled sensor chip, a probe on a comb-shaped holder, and an SEM of gears with a partly legible label "SEM of gear assembly." The caption reads "Figure 1. Varieties of BioMEMS and Sensors. These BioMEMS devices were made at Arizona State University (ASU)." Text below begins "Characteristics of BioMEMS."
